parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name group. If you do not specify this parameter, pass an empty string, or pass defaultGroup, the domain name is added to the default group. You can call the AddDomainGroup operation to obtain the group ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the domain name belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the domain name is added to the default resource group.
